## Nightbringer Ape (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
CE Large magical beast  
**Init** +0 **Senses** darkvision 90 ft., see in darkness, scent; Perception +10  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 9, flat-footed 17 (+8 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 147 (14d10+70); **DR** 5/magic  
**Fort** +15, **Ref** +11, **Will** +6  
**Weaknesses** light sensitivity  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., climb 40 ft.  
**Melee** two +23 slams (1d12+9 bludgeoning, 19-20/x2)  
**Melee** (in darkness) two +24 slams (3d12+9 bludgeoning, 19-20/x2), sneak attack +3d6  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 11th Concentration +13)  

At Will—dimension door  
3x/day—darkness  
1x/day—deeper darkness  


**Statistics**


**Str** 28, **Dex** 11, **Con** 19, **Int** 7, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +14; **CMB** +24 (+29 in darkness); **CMD** 34 (39 in darkness)  
**Feats** Cleave, Great Cleave, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (slam), Lightning Reflexes, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Focus (two)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (two).*  
**Skills** Intimidate +8, Perception +10, Stealth +7; **Racial Modifiers** +6 Stealth  
**Languages** understands one language but cannot speak  


**Special Abilities**


**Night Magic (Sp)** A nightbringer ape can only use its dimension door in areas of dim illumination; both the departure point and destination must be in dim illumination or worse.  

**Nocturnal Predator (Su)** A nightbringer ape uses the night itself as a weapon. In areas of dim illumination or worse, the nightbringer ape’s attacks are especially deadly; the nightbringer ape receives a +2 bonus on attack rolls, one additional dice of damage, and a +5 bonus on its CMB and CMD values.
